mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic stimulus supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, raising equity discount rates and reducing forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units (HOUST > 1400) signal robust residential construction activity that drives consumer confidence and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 265 and GDPC1 above 20000 billion signal high inflation with strong GDP growth, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint CPIAUCSL > 265 and GDPC1 > 20000 signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial output signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
